package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type learningWorkspaceGetterStub struct {
	result domain.StudentLearningWorkspace
	err    error
	calls  int
}

type learningWorkspaceReaderHTTPStub struct{ calls int }

func (stub *learningWorkspaceReaderHTTPStub) ReadLearningWorkspace(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, nil
}

func (stub *learningWorkspaceGetterStub) Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.result, stub.err
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceRequiresServiceTokenAndIsNoStore(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	getter := &learningWorkspaceGetterStub{result: domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{
		Schema: domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema, ContextVersion: 3,
		SelectedPath: &domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath{
			LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, PathVersion: 2,
			Items: []domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady}},
		},
	}}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.LearningWorkspace = getter
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "", "teacher-token")
	path := "/students/" + studentID + "/learning-workspace"
	unauthorized := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthorized, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil))
	if unauthorized.Code != http.StatusForbidden || getter.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized status=%d calls=%d", unauthorized.Code, getter.calls)
	}
	generalToken := httptest.NewRecorder()
	generalRequest := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	generalRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "general-token")
	router.ServeHTTP(generalToken, generalRequest)
	if generalToken.Code != http.StatusForbidden || getter.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("general token status=%d calls=%d", generalToken.Code, getter.calls)
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || getter.calls != 1 || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" ||
		!strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"schema":"student-learning-workspace.v1"`) ||
		strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "student_id") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "curriculum_revision") {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d cache=%q body=%s", response.Code, getter.calls, response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceDisabledBeforeRepositoryAccess(t *testing.T) {
	reader := &learningWorkspaceReaderHTTPStub{}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.LearningWorkspace = studentuc.GetLearningWorkspace{Reader: reader}
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "", "teacher-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-workspace", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || reader.calls != 0 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"learning_workspace_disabled"`) || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d reader_calls=%d cache=%q body=%s", response.Code, reader.calls, response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceRejectsInvalidStudentID(t *testing.T) {
	getter := &learningWorkspaceGetterStub{err: domain.ErrValidation}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.LearningWorkspace = getter
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "", "teacher-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/students/not-a-uuid/learning-workspace", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || getter.calls != 1 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"invalid_student_id"`) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, getter.calls, response.Body.String())
	}
}
